messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: serving-runtime - high error rate and latency in us-west-2 (auto-signal). links: https://alerts.redwood/INC-1728888000 :rotating_light:
oncall-rotation: @Alex Kim you're on primary oncall, could you take?
Alex Kim: Ack, looking. just landed in console. seeing continuous-batcher queue length jump on several nodes. first signs are at ~10:12 UTC.
Priya Shah: Any immediate customer impact?
Marco Diaz: A few high-value tenants showing 5xx spikes and token throttles. p95 latency up from 120ms to 2.4s; errors ~12% on serving routes.
Alex Kim: attaching quick logs snapshot:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:07Z] runtime: continuous-batcher[id=cb-47] queue_len=142000 kv_cache_bytes=78GB
[2026-03-15T10:12:12Z] container cb-47: OOMKilled (OOM) - kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 23456 (llama_serv) total-vm:...
[2026-03-15T10:12:13Z] cuda: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS at /serving/runtime/attention.cu:2412
[2026-03-15T10:12:14Z] node node-usw2-12: kubelet: liveness probe failed - restarting container
```
Jenna Liu: Ugh, looks like the KV cache growth + unbounded batch aggregation. Could be a regression in the continuous batching deadlock path.
ops-bot: autoscaler: scale-up triggered for nodepool-g4x (3 -> 6), but several nodes reporting kernel OOMs and flapping.
Sam O'Connor: Priority mitigation: stop the batcher ingestion path (safe fast rollback) and fail traffic to on-prem-compatible fallback model. We should also cordon any flapping nodes.
Alex Kim: Agreed. Plan: (1) set continuous_batching.enabled=false via feature flag for the affected fleet, (2) scale down continuous-batcher Deployment replicas to 0 for canary and then progressively for prod, (3) cordon flapping nodes and drain traffic, (4) route traffic to smaller quantized model as fallback. I'll start 1 and 2.
Priya Shah: Tagging support and CSMs: customers A+B might see degraded throughput for ~5-15m while we failover. notify if ETA changes.
Alex Kim: Running command now:
```
# flip feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://admin-gw/flags -d '{"continuous_batching.enabled": false, "target": "us-west-2"}'
# scale down batcher
kubectl -n serving scale deployment continuous-batcher --replicas=0 --context=usw2
```
Marco Diaz: I can start cordoning nodes with the flapper list: node-usw2-{12,15,19}. Doing node-usw2-12 first.
ops-bot: node-usw2-12 cordoned by Marco Diaz. drain job started.
Alex Kim: After flip + scale: queue length dropping on metric stream. kv_cache_bytes decaying from 78GB -> 12GB across 3m. OOM events subsided.
Jenna Liu: Any CUDA error repeats after restart?
Alex Kim: No new CUDA errors in last 90s. Some containers still restarting but liveness stable.
Sam O'Connor: Rolling traffic to fallback model: edge-router -> model-q4_128 (lower mem). Adding route rule now.
```
# router rule
POST /routes/modify {"route":"/generate","fallback_model":"model-q4_128","weight":100}
```
Priya Shah: Support update sent to SRE channel and affected AEs. Notifying customers with planned mitigation window.
Marco Diaz: Monitoring p95 now trending back down: 2.4s -> 480ms -> 180ms over 10m. Error rate back to 0.7%.
Alex Kim: Confirming: continuous-batching rollback + node cordon + fallback model reduced memory pressure and prevented further OOMs. Preparing follow-up: rollback PR to batching change, add circuit breaker for queue_len and KV cache cap.
Jenna Liu: Filing incident ticket + postmortem owner. I'll own the postmortem. Follow-ups: add metric alert for kv_cache_bytes per pod, tighten liveness probes, add automatic batcher throttle when queue > 10k.
Sam O'Connor: Nice work. Next steps for now: keep batchers scaled to 0 until we validate a patched build in staging and run soak.
Alex Kim: Agreed. Leaving a watch for 30m, then hand to next oncall if stable.
oncall-rotation: Thanks @Alex Kim, handing to @Priya Shah for escalation watch at 11:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident state changed: INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATING (1728888200).
ops-bot: Deploy bot reports restart of continuous-batcher replicas blocked by scale-to-zero; all good.
Priya Shah: All right, I'll watch and escalate to infra if nodes continue to flap. Great triage everyone. :thumbsup:
Jenna Liu: Postmortem created: https://pm.redwood/incidents/1728888000 - tasks assigned.
Alex Kim: Closing slack thread for now, will reopen on any regressions. :white_check_mark:
